# Column 5 = Agent name, Columns 6-14 = Category 1-9
agent_categories = {}
for row in range(4, 10):  # rows 4-9
    agent = sheet.cell(row=row, column=5).value
    if agent:
        categories = {}
        for col in range(6, 15):  # columns 6-14 (Category 1-9)
            category_num = col - 5  # Category 1 = col 6, so category_num = 1
            category_name = f"Category {category_num}"

        agent_categories[agent] = categories

for agent, cats in agent_categories.items():
    print(f"  {agent}: {cats}")

# Extract Agent Schedule (rows 13-18, columns 6-31)
# Column 5 = Agent name, Columns 6-31 = time intervals
agent_schedule = {}
for row in range(13, 19):  # rows 13-18
    agent = sheet.cell(row=row, column=5).value
    if agent:
        schedule = []
        for col in range(6, 32):  # columns 6-31 (26 time intervals)
            is_scheduled = sheet.cell(row=row, column=col).value
            schedule.append(1 if is_scheduled == 1 else 0)
        agent_schedule[agent] = schedule

print("\nAgent Schedule:")
for agent, sched in agent_schedule.items():
    print(f"  {agent}: {sched}")

# Calculate results for each category and time interval
# Result table: rows 22-29 (Category 1-8), columns 6-31 (26 time intervals)
# Answer position: F22:AE29 (columns 6-31, rows 22-29)

    category = sheet.cell(row=result_row, column=5).value
    if category:
        print(f"\nProcessing {category}:")
        for time_col in range(6, 32):  # columns 6-31 (26 time intervals)
            time_index = time_col - 6  # 0-25
            
            # Count agents who are:
            # 1. Scheduled at this time interval (agent_schedule[agent][time_index] == 1)
            # 2. Have this category assigned (agent_categories[agent][category] == 1)
            count = 0
            for agent in agent_categories.keys():
                if agent in agent_schedule:
                    is_scheduled = agent_schedule[agent][time_index]
                    has_category = agent_categories[agent].get(category, 0)
                    if is_scheduled == 1 and has_category == 1:
                        count += 1
            
            # Write the count to the cell
            sheet.cell(row=result_row, column=time_col, value=count)
            if time_index < 3:  # Print first few for verification
                print(f"  Time interval {time_index}: {count}")
